meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把实现工作放进任务专属的 git worktree,按 ulw-loop 做证据绑定的手动 QA,再开英文 PR、跑 CI 与 Cubic 检查,默认自动合并并清理 worktree;任务会拆成最小的原子 PR,独立的并行推进。
howto.when: 当你说“创建 PR”、“实现并提 PR”、“把这件事落地成 PR”等说法,或上下文暗示改动要以 PR 交付时,即使只说“实现 X”也会触发。

say.text: 把这个问题实现成 PR,先拆成最小的原子 PR,独立的并行开。
把这个 PR 的 CI 和 Cubic 反馈修完,然后合并。
say.note: 失败会退回该 PR 的 worktree 修复并重做 QA。

say.text: 这次改动太大,拆成几个能独立合并的 PR。
say.note: 每个 PR 各自一个 worktree,走完整流程。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the PR lifecycle in a task-owned git worktree: implements via ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, opens an English PR, loops on CI and Cubic, merges by default, then cleans up. Independent atomic PRs build in parallel.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "create a PR", "implement and PR", "land this as a PR" or similar, or when context implies the work must land as a PR — even if you just say "implement X".

say_en.text: Turn this issue into PRs, split atomically, build independent ones in parallel.
say_en.note: Sets up worktrees, implements via ulw-loop with manual QA.

say_en.text: Fix the CI and Cubic feedback on this PR, then merge it.
say_en.note: Failures route back to that PR's worktree for fix and re-QA.

say_en.text: This change is too big — split it into separately mergeable PRs.
say_en.note: Each slice gets its own worktree and full lifecycle.
